description_short: Paul Manafort Joins Trump Campaign, Hides Pro-Putin Ukraine Work

The Senate Intelligence Committee later documented Manafort’s role and contacts; he was subsequently convicted of financial crimes and pleaded guilty to additional charges.

Before joining, he had worked for years as a political consultant to Ukraine’s Viktor Yanukovych and associated interests. The Senate Intelligence Committee’s investigation documented Manafort’s campaign role, his contacts with Russian-linked figures, and his financial relationship with oligarch Oleg Deripaska.
